subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should generic outbound delivery adopt operation-capable same-id plugin precedence while QQBot reconnect replay bypasses normal queue backoff for connection and outbound-resolution errors?
rationale: The implementation follows established resolver and queue seams, but these choices define cross-plugin compatibility and message-retry timing that tests cannot establish as permanent product policy.

options.title: Accept both policies
options.body: Land the current approach after shared outbound and QQBot lifecycle owners confirm the precedence and immediate-retry filter.

options.title: Keep normal queue backoff
options.body: Retain reconnect-triggered draining but use `bypassBackoff: false` so existing queue timing remains unchanged.

options.title: Split the policy surfaces
options.body: Land the generic resolver repair separately and review QQBot reconnect replay timing in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept both policies
recommendation.body: Land the current approach after shared outbound and QQBot lifecycle owners confirm the precedence and immediate-retry filter.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the outbound resolver and gateway-send surfaces, making this the strongest available owner signal for coordinating the cross-channel decision.
